mechanism_narrative: A quarterly increase in GDPC1 exceeding 2% YoY signals strengthening demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 50% of quarters with GDPC1 YoY growth > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained FEDFUNDS rate below 0.5% indicates accommodative monetary policy, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns during periods with FEDFUNDS < 0.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When UNRATE falls below 4% and PAYEMS growth exceeds 200,000 jobs per month, the labor market's strength predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.02 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in INDPRO exceeding 1.5% MoM signals supply chain resilience, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 40% of months with INDPRO MoM growth > 1.5%.

mechanism_narrative: RSAFS growth exceeding $500,000,000 MoM, coupled with HOUST growth above 10,000 units MoM, indicates robust demand, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS MoM growth > $500,000,000 and HOUST MoM growth > 10,000
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this mechanism remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL increase above 0.5% MoM, accompanied by a FEDFUNDS rate above 1%, signals monetary policy tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 55% of instances with CPIAUCSL MoM growth > 0.5% and FEDFUNDS > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: Always-on: the labor market's overall health, as measured by UNRATE, predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days, regardless of other conditions.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly correlated with UNRATE (Pearson's r < 0.1).

mechanism_narrative: In a post-shock recovery regime, a GDPC1 quarterly increase exceeding 1% YoY signals demand recovery, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for this mechanism in post-shock recovery regimes remains below 0.05 over any 1.5-year rolling window.
